memoryRule: a complete route through four distinct junctions stays exact while three remote junctions turn, splice, and stutter the surrounding paths; four rewirings persist
interactionRule: trace four distinct junctions with pointer or touch, use ArrowRight, or use the rewire control; Enter or Space commits; Delete lifts latest; R or Escape releases
representationRupture: browser-native DOM lexicon, folded SVG sentence, and Canvas fragment ecology -> one continuous Canvas 2D route topology with no readable words in the blind field
compositionRupture: asymmetrical word field, folded sentence, and distributed fragments -> braided route sheet with open junction collars and a broken central crossing
encounterRupture: typed token ratification, pressure sweep, and attention offer -> continuous traversal through four junctions before an explicit topological commit
temporalRupture: ratification history, pressure seam memory, and remote attention ledger -> persistent route rewiring at three unvisited junctions with exact lifting
mediumRupture: browser-native DOM text, inline SVG paths, and Canvas typographic fragments -> Canvas 2D produced topology of curves, collars, crossings, and route state
changedRule: A route through four distinct junctions is geometry-neutral while traced. Only commitment rewires three unselected junctions and their surrounding paths; every selected junction remains exact.
visibleConsequence: The blind view is a continuous braided route sheet with no words to read. A valid route changes remote bend, position, width, and phase through actual Canvas geometry while the selected junctions stay exact; four rewirings persist.
falsifier: Delete if tracing changes geometry early, if repeated junctions commit, if selected junctions answer themselves, if remote change is only colour or readout, if the blind field reads as a generic route diagram, or if later routes reset.
deletionCondition: Delete v039 if caption-free viewing cannot distinguish the topological route sheet from v036-v038 or if a completed route does not materially alter unselected path geometry.
promotion: candidate / held pending local and production browser matrices, blind perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
